annotations.title: Turn on real-time Snapchat lead delivery

description: Have Snapchat PUSH every new lead from a lead form to Hermoso the moment it is submitted — the ONLY way Snapchat hands leads to an API (it has no endpoint that lists leads), so leads submitted before this was on are never delivered. action 'subscribe' (default) turns it on, read back from Snapchat; forwardTo (public https) also relays each lead to a CRM, Zapier or Make. 'list' shows the form's webhooks; 'test' makes Snapchat send its sample lead and waits for it to ARRIVE at Hermoso, which proves delivery end to end; 'delete' removes a webhook (confirm:true; one Hermoso did not make may feed the advertiser's own CRM, and the refusal says so). Snapchat allows ONE webhook per form and requires Organization Admin on the Snapchat organization. Every delivery is verified against Snapchat's HMAC signature before it is stored. Read leads with list_snapchat_ads_leads. Free.

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account id shared with this profile; omit when only one is shared

forwardTo.description: optional public https URL each lead is also forwarded to

integrationId.description: for delete, or test of one integration
